tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Semantic search over active Polish public tenders (przetargi) by meaning, with optional filters. Ranks by relevance (hybrid vector + keyword). Returns paginated tender cards, each with a public URL. Only publicly-servable tenders with an AI summary are returned. `mode` is 'semantic', or 'lexical' wh

tools.name: list_tenders
tools.description: Browse tenders without a text query. `filter` selects the axis: 'all' (every active tender, or archived when archived=true), 'category' (CPV division code from list_facets), 'region' (voivodeship slug from list_facets), or 'city' (city slug from list_facets). Use list_facets first to get valid value

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: List the browsable facets of the active tender set: CPV categories, voivodeships (regions), and cities, each with a count and the slug/code to pass to list_tenders. Call this to discover valid filter values.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Fetch full detail for one tender by its public slug (from search_tenders/list_tenders results): metadata, the 12-section AI SWZ summary, the OPZ scope brief, and award results. Returns not-found for non-public tenders.

tools.name: cpv_search
tools.description: Resolve free-text to CPV codes (the EU Common Procurement Vocabulary used to classify tenders). Returns matching codes with Polish labels. Use the codes with list_tenders filter='category' (division = first 8 digits).

tools.name: cpv_tree
tools.description: Walk the CPV hierarchy. Omit `parent` for top-level divisions; pass a code (e.g. '45000000-7') to list its children. Each node flags whether it has children.

tools.name: cpv_labels
tools.description: Resolve CPV codes to their Polish labels. Pass an array of full codes (e.g. ['45000000-7']).

tools.name: list_my_tenders
tools.description: List the tenders in the signed-in user's pipeline ('Moje przetargi'), most recently updated first, with each one's pipeline status and public URL. Requires OAuth authentication.

tools.name: list_my_alerts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved alert profiles (saved searches / notification rules): query, CPV codes, regions, budget band, and delivery settings. Requires OAuth authentication.

tools.name: search_my_tenders
tools.description: Plan-gated hybrid search over active tenders for the signed-in user's organization (the same search as the in-app command palette). Requires OAuth authentication and an active plan.
